title: The Cross and the Fishstairs — Sill's market and the steps below the north bridge
caption: The ground the boy is carried over on every Account-day, drawn at the scale of the market: the market square with its stalls, the reading block under the moot-post and its finger's width of shade, the eight pigs on the weighing rail and the turnips left standing with figures beside them, the Court's table at the Slate Row fringe; below the north bridge the Fishstairs counting four steps, four, and the out-of-line landing, the edge of the fish-trade in the bridge's shadow, Rusk's room, the hard sill and the Singing Sill under the water, the dotted line of the Breaking, and the south bridge on the way to Low Kiln. Surveyed and inked in Y.H. 813, the reed month.
